states.name: q
states.meaning: Registered 8-bit D flip-flop output; loads d on a positive clk edge when reset is low, and is synchronously cleared to 0 on a positive clk edge when reset is high.
states.update_time: posedge clk after reset priority evaluation

rules.spec_quote: active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero
Create 8 D flip-flops with active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero. All DFFs should be triggered by the positive edge of clk.

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: the first posedge clk at which reset is sampled low; q then loads d

mid: If present, mid input changes occur after the sampled posedge and are carried to the start of the next row; synchronous q updates only at posedge clk.
